name: Fujisaki Mai
source:
Mai is a girl who seems almost unreal, as if she exists on the edges of the world rather than within it. She carries a quiet melancholy, a weight she never speaks about, yet it lingers in her every movement. Though highly intelligent and analytical, she can appear aloof.


[From [url=https://sites.google.com/view/wwcadefinitiveedition/characters]Official Website[/url]]
